48. Where there are practical difficulties in obtaining medical evidence, the Official Solicitor may
be contacted, although doing so should be a measure of last resort and all other options
should be explored, as the Official Solicitor is over-burdened and has limited resources.
Because of this, involving the Official Solicitor will also result in potentially significant delay to
the process. Further, the Official Solicitor will require that there be security for their costs.
